children: Ferrovial N.V. (BME:FER) recorded operating profit of €848 million through September, down 12% year over year, while revenue rose 7.1% to €7.402 billion. Its U.S. unit Webber won a $537.9 million contract to build a Fort Worth wastewater plant.
: Ferrovial’s operating profit fell 12% year over year to €848 million through September, partly due to lower asset-sale gains. Revenue rose 7.1% to €7.402 billion.
: Ferrovial (FER), via U.S. unit Webber, won a $537.9 million contract to build a Fort Worth wastewater plant. Work starts in November 2026; completion is due in summer 2030.
: Ferrovial set its second 2026 flexible dividend cash option at €0.835 per share. Shareholders can choose cash or shares Nov. 9–20; shares go ex-dividend Nov. 5 in Spain and Nov. 6 on Nasdaq.
: - Citigroup upgraded Ferrovial N.V. (FER) from Neutral to Buy.
